name: Ideal Reconstruction Function for 3D Splatting
definition: A 3D reconstruction filter kernel h(x,y,z) designed to provide smooth overlap from any viewing direction with minimal extent, replacing polygon approximations to eliminate Mach bands.
summary: The Ideal Reconstruction Function for 3D Splatting is a rotationally symmetric kernel that minimizes reconstruction variance to eliminate Mach bands and visible splat boundaries, distinguishing itself from Gaussian splats through its finite support and optimized smooth overlap.
